learning_outcomes.text: To train students in methods for analyzing complex mechanical systems.
To introduce students to design methods using simple systems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to a CAD tool: 3D geometric modeling of components, assembly of components, editing technical documents
Analysis and modeling of simple systems: Principle diagram, kinematic and technological diagram, Block diagram (action-flow), hyperstaticity
Analysis of real systems: Disassembly, analysis and reassembly of systems in practical sessions
Analysis and modeling of complex systems
Introduction to functional dimensioning: Elaboration of the definition drawing of a part
Bases and methods for system design: needs analysis, systemic approach, sizing of a power transmission, definition of complete liaisons and simple guidances. Digital mock-ups of the system
assessment_rules: Evaluation is based on a skills grid, assessed continuously during practical and tutorial sessions, through projects, and by a final examination.
institution: Ecole Nationale Superieure De Mecanique Et Des Microtechnique
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur ENSMM (cycle ingénieur, spécialité Mécanique) — 1.er y 2.º año
